systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Arts and Culture: the EMIS division in the Directorate of Planning and Development, with a database management and administration sub-division
systems.tiers: education regions collect data twice a year from all state and private schools; the division publishes the Fifteenth School Day Report and the Annual Education Census; January 2024 totals of 2,036 schools, 885,750 learners and 26,356 teachers

note: The page describes two collections a year by the regions and two published reports, which is a census; it says nothing of schools entering learner records, and nothing on whether schools' own records are on paper or how the returns are captured.
